svg.aria-label: What to expect at 4K: how much less time FSR 4 takes per frame with this project's builds than with AMD's own, card by card, moving scene, Balanced. RX 7800 XT, Linux (this project): exact 37%, lossy 55% less time than AMD's FSR 4.1.2; 4.1.2l-exact 9%, 4.1.2l-lossy 21% less than AMD's Lite. RX 7900 XTX, Windows (1 report): exact 34%, lossy 53% less time than AMD's FSR 4.1.2; 4.1.2l-exact 11%, 4.1.2l-lossy no report less than AMD's Lite. RX 7900 XT, Windows (2 reports): exact 23%, lossy 45% less time than AMD's FSR 4.1.2; 4.1.2l-exact 12%, 4.1.2l-lossy 19% less than AMD's Lite. RX 7700 XT, Windows (6 reports): exact 34%, lossy 52% less time than AMD's FSR 4.1.2; 4.1.2l-exact 2% more, 4.1.2l-lossy 14% less than AMD's Lite. RX 7600, Windows (8 reports): exact 31%, lossy 45% less time than AMD's FSR 4.1.2; 4.1.2l-exact 15%, 4.1.2l-lossy 20% less than AMD's Lite. RX 6800 XT, Windows (4 reports): exact 5%, lossy 26% less time than AMD's FSR 4.1.2; 4.1.2l-exact 7%, 4.1.2l-lossy 15% less than AMD's Lite. RX 6800, Windows (6 reports): exact 3%, lossy 24% less time than AMD's FSR 4.1.2; 4.1.2l-exact 12%, 4.1.2l-lossy 15% less than AMD's Lite. RX 6750 XT, Windows (14 reports): exact 2%, lossy 23% less time than AMD's FSR 4.1.2; 4.1.2l-exact 11%, 4.1.2l-lossy 15% less than AMD's Lite. RX 6700 XT, Windows (1 report): exact 1%, lossy 23% less time than AMD's FSR 4.1.2; 4.1.2l-exact 11%, 4.1.2l-lossy 14% less than AMD's Lite. RX 6650 XT, Windows (2 reports): exact 4%, lossy 24% less time than AMD's FSR 4.1.2; 4.1.2l-exact 9%, 4.1.2l-lossy 14% less than AMD's Lite. RX 6600 XT, Windows (1 report): exact 4%, lossy no report less time than AMD's FSR 4.1.2; 4.1.2l-exact 6%, 4.1.2l-lossy no report less than AMD's Lite. RX 6600, Windows (2 reports): exact 4%, lossy 24% less time than AMD's FSR 4.1.2; 4.1.2l-exact 9%, 4.1.2l-lossy 15% less than AMD's Lite. The Windows rows come from testers' timing-kit reports with this release's shaders. Other resolutions give other numbers.
svg.text: How much less time FSR 4 takes per frame than with AMD's own. Longer is faster.
This project's RX 7800 XT, Linux (Proton): the release's builds
Windows, testers' timing-kit reports (this release's shaders; median per card)
Moving scene, 4K output, Balanced. AMD's FSR 4.1.2 is the card's own model: on RX 7000 it gives FSR 4.1.1's picture, on RX 6000 a picture that
differs only in rounding. Linux row: AMD's FSR 4.1.2 = its FSR SDK 2.4.0 game DLL; Lite in this project's local test harness; two runs each.
Windows rows: timing-kit test builds with this release's shaders, against AMD's FSR SDK 2.4.0 DLL in the same report. 1080p, 1440p and other
cards: the tables below. Linux gains do not carry over to Windows.
The two panels have different scales: 0 to 60% on the left, 0 to 25% on the right.
